data.content:
Here's the complete implementation:

**Project structure:**
```
TicketClassifier/
├── Controllers/TicketController.cs   # API endpoints
├── Data/tickets.csv                  # Training data
├── Models/TicketData.cs              # ML + API models
├── Services/TicketClassifierService.cs # ML.NET training & prediction
├── Program.cs                        # DI & app setup
└── TicketClassifier.csproj           # .NET 10 + ML.NET 4.0.2
```

**Endpoints:**
- `POST /api/ticket/classify` — Predicts category (Billing/Technical/General) with confidence scores
- `GET /api/ticket/metrics` — Returns evaluation metrics (MacroAccuracy, MicroAccuracy, LogLoss, LogLossReduction)

**How it works:**
1. On startup, loads `tickets.csv`, splits 70/30 train/test
2. Builds an ML pipeline: text featurization (Subject + Description) + Priority → SDCA Maximum Entropy multiclass classifier
3. Evaluates on the test set and exposes metrics
4. Prediction engine classifies new tickets with per-category confidence scores

**Note:** Metrics show low accuracy because the training CSV has only 6 rows. Add more labeled tickets to `Data/tickets.csv` for production-quality results.
